title: HOUSE / FIELD
purpose: Public-safe projection of addressed physical resources, capabilities, integration health and evidence for one household control plane. Private runtime authority remains Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS.

current_surface.generator: private normalizer in the HOUSEBUS repository (scripts/project-public.py)
current_surface.refresh: manual: run the generator, then commit the regenerated state.json
current_surface.semantics: A projection with a timestamp, not a live feed. Staleness or silence is not evidence of danger.

forbidden_classes: vendor device identifiers that function as credentials
enforcement: The generator builds the public document by whitelist and then scans the serialized JSON for forbidden patterns; it refuses to write on any match. The committed state.json carries its own sanitization result.
kernel_role: OBJECT -> ADDRESS -> PROJECT (this page). OPERATE is private (Home Assistant). RETURN is /returns/ plus the receipt ledger.

spatial_state.relation: Spatial State Engine supplies ADDRESS/PROJECT semantics; Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS retains OPERATE authority.
spatial_state.thin_slice: 2D room/object graph + manual state + explicit HA entity mapping; add sensors only where they remove real friction.
